```{r}
#### BAIXAR E FORMATAR A SERIE ##################################################################
get_data = function(tickers = "PETR4.SA", first_date = "2005-01-01", last_date = (Sys.Date())){
  data = yf_get(tickers, first_date, last_date)
  data = na.omit(data[,c(2,8,9)])
  colnames(data) = c("date", "adjusted", "ret_adjusted")
  return(data)
}
#### GERAR GRAFICO INTERATIVO (DYGRAPHS) ########################################################
get_graph_main = function(data, way = "adj"){
  if(way == "adj"){
    don = xts(x = data$adjusted, order.by = data$date)
  }
  if(way == "ret"){
    don = xts(x = data$ret_adjusted, order.by = data$date)
  }
  p <- dygraph(don) %>%
    dyOptions(labelsUTC = TRUE, fillGraph=TRUE, fillAlpha=0.1, drawGrid = FALSE, colors="#D8AE5A") %>%
    dyRangeSelector() %>%
    dyCrosshair(direction = "vertical") %>%
    dyHighlight(highlightCircleSize = 5, highlightSeriesBackgroundAlpha = 1, hideOnMouseOut = FALSE)  %>%
    dySeries("V1", label = "Price")
  return(p)
}
#### CONSEGUIR AS PREVISÕES DO MODELO ############################################################
get_prev_model = function(dados, distribution = "norm", arima_order = c(0,0,0), garch_order = c(0,0), h = 5){
  sequencia = seq(from = max(dados$date)+1, by = 1, length.out = 5)
  dados = na.omit(dados)
  dados$index = 1:nrow(dados)
  ts_df = as_tsibble(dados, index = index)
  
  is.garch = !all(garch_order == 0)
  
  if(!is.garch){
    modelo = arima(dados$ret_adjusted, order = arima_order)
    prev = predict(modelo, n.ahead = h)
  }
  if(is.garch){
    spec = ugarchspec(mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(arima_order[1], arima_order[3]),
                                          include.mean = FALSE),
                        variance.model = list(model = 'sGARCH', garchOrder = garch_order),
                        distribution = distribution)
    modelo =  ugarchfit(spec, dados$ret_adjusted, solver = 'hybrid')
    prev = ugarchforecast(modelo, n.ahead = h)
    prev = cbind(prev@forecast$seriesFor, prev@forecast$sigmaFor)
    rownames(prev) = NULL
  }
  
  prev = as.data.frame(prev)
  prev$index= sequencia
  colnames(prev) = c("Retorno", "Desvio padrão", "idx")
  return(list(prev, modelo))
}
#### CONSEGUIR GRAFICOS DE DIAGNOSTICO DO MODELO ########################################################
get_graph_model = function(dados, distribution = "norm",
                           arima_order = c(0,0,0), garch_order = c(0,0), h = 5){
  
  infos = get_prev_model(dados = dados, distribution = distribution,
                         arima_order = arima_order, garch_order = garch_order, h = h)
  prev = infos[[1]]
  modelo = infos[[2]]
  
  is.garch = !all(garch_order == 0)
  
  if(!is.garch){
    residuos = modelo$residuals
  }
  if(is.garch){
    residuos = modelo@fit$residuals
  }
  
  aux <- data.frame(idx = 1:length(residuos),
                    res = residuos)
  
  plot_seq <- ggplot(aux, aes(x = idx, y = res))+
    geom_line()+
    geom_point()
  
  acf <- acf(aux$res, plot = F) 
  acf <- data.frame(idx = factor(seq(1,length(acf$acf[,,1]))),
                    acf = acf$acf[,,1])
  acf <- ggplot(acf)+
    geom_segment(aes(x = idx, xend = idx, y = 0, yend=acf))+
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0))+
    geom_hline(data = data.frame(nrow = nrow(dados)),
               aes(yintercept = 1.96/sqrt(nrow)), color = "blue", linetype = 2)+
    geom_hline(data = data.frame(nrow = nrow(dados)),
               aes(yintercept = -1.96/sqrt(nrow)), color = "blue", linetype = 2)+
    theme_bw()
  
  
  
  if(distribution == "norm"){
    qqplot <- ggplot(aux, aes(sample = res))+
      geom_qq()
  }
  
  hist_res <- ggplot(aux, aes(x = res))+
    geom_histogram()
    
  plot_grid <- (plot_seq)/(acf+qqplot+hist_res)
  return(plot(plot_grid))
}
```

```{r}
#### SERVER DO DASHBOARD EM SHINY ##############################################
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  ##Gráficos da aba Série Fechamento############################
  output$serie_grafico <- renderDygraph({plot})
  output$serie_acf <- renderPlot({acf})
  output$serie_pacf <- renderPlot({pacf})
  output$serie_sazonal <- renderPlot({saz})
  ##############################################################
  
  ##Gráficos da aba Série Retorno###############################
  output$serie_grafico_r <- renderDygraph({plot_r})
  output$serie_acf_r <- renderPlot({acf_r})
  output$serie_acf2_r <- renderPlot({acf2_r})
  output$serie_pacf_r <- renderPlot({pacf_r})
  output$serie_sazonal_r <- renderPlot({saz_r})
  ##############################################################
  
  ##Aba Modelos#################################################
output$modelo_user <- renderUI({
  id <- input$modelo_nome |> as.numeric()
  if (id == 1) {
    inputs <- tagList(
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("ARIMA_AR", "AR", value = NULL)),
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("ARIMA_I", "I", value = NULL)),
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("ARIMA_MA", "MA", value = NULL)))
    )
    return(inputs)
  }
  if (id == 2) {
    inputs <- tagList(
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("GARCH_AR", "AR", value = NULL)),
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("GARCH_MA", "MA", value = NULL)),
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("GARCH_1", "GARCH 1", value = NULL)),
        column(width = 2,
               textInput("GARCH_2", "GARCH 2", value = NULL)))
    )
    return(inputs)
  }
})

output$graficos_user <- renderUI({
  id <- input$modelo_nome |> as.numeric()
  if (id == 1) {
    arima_p <- c(input$ARIMA_AR, input$ARIMA_I, input$ARIMA_MA) |> as.numeric() |> na.omit()
    totalidade <- length(arima_p)
    if (totalidade == 3) {
      graficos_user <- plotOutput("graficos_user_plot")
      return(graficos_user)
    }
  }
  if (id == 2) {
    garch_arma <- c(input$GARCH_AR, 0, input$GARCH_MA) |> as.numeric() |> na.omit()
    garch_p <- c(input$GARCH_1, input$GARCH_2) |> as.numeric() |> na.omit()
    total1 <- length(garch_arma)
    total2 <- length(garch_p)
    if (total1 == 3 && total2 == 2) {
      graficos_user <- plotOutput("graficos_user_plot")
      return(graficos_user)
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
})

output$graficos_user_plot <- renderPlot({
  id <- input$modelo_nome |> as.numeric()
  if (id == 1) {
    arima_p <- c(input$ARIMA_AR, input$ARIMA_I, input$ARIMA_MA) |> as.numeric() |> na.omit()
    totalidade <- length(arima_p)
    if (totalidade == 3) {
      graficos_user <- get_graph_model(dados = dados, arima_order = arima_p, garch_order = c(0, 0))
      return(graficos_user)
    }
  }
  if (id == 2) {
    garch_arma <- c(input$GARCH_AR, 0, input$GARCH_MA) |> as.numeric() |> na.omit()
    garch_p <- c(input$GARCH_1, input$GARCH_2) |> as.numeric() |> na.omit()
    total1 <- length(garch_arma)
    total2 <- length(garch_p)
    if (total1 == 3 && total2 == 2) {
      graficos_user <- get_graph_model(dados = dados, arima_order = garch_arma, garch_order = garch_p)
      return(graficos_user)
    }
  }
})
  
  ##############################################################
  
  ##Mover o slide com as setas do teclado#######################
  id_tab = reactiveVal(1)
  observeEvent(input$keys, {
    todas_tabs = c("Título", "Explicação", "Introdução", "Contexto",
                   "Série fechamento", "Série retorno", "Modelos",
                   "Modelo Escolhido", "Validação", "Conclusão")
    inputado = input$keys
    id = isolate(id_tab())
    if(inputado == "left"){
      if(id > 1){
        id = id - 1
      }
    }
    if(inputado == "right"){
      if(id < length(todas_tabs)){
        id = id + 1
      }
    }
    id_tab(id)
    
    updateTabItems(session, "tabs", selected = todas_tabs[id])
  })
  ##############################################################
}
```
